recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crispy tortillas packed with chicken, melty cheddar and peppers. Dinner on the table in 15 minutes.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cumin. Scatter cheese, chicken and pepper over half of each tortilla, then more cheese on top.
Fold the tortillas in half and press down.
Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: 15-Minute Garlic Butter Noodles
recipes.description: Buttery, garlicky noodles with a salty hit of soy and parmesan. Pantry staples, big comfort.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water. Save half a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter in the same pot over medium-low heat and cook the garlic for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey, add the noodles and a splash of pasta water, and toss until glossy.
Toss with parmesan and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: The best use for leftover rice: scrambled egg, peas and soy, all in one hot pan.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook the carrot and peas for 2 minutes.
Push the vegetables aside, crack in the eggs and scramble until just set.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until hot and a little crisp.
Stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil, and finish with scallions.

recipes.title: Mini Pizza Bagels
recipes.description: Bagel halves topped with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni. Kids can build their own.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet.
Spread each bagel half with sauce, then top with mozzarella and pepperoni.
Sprinkle with oregano and bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese bubbles.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
recipes.description: Crunchy toast, creamy peanut butter, sliced banana and a drizzle of honey. Breakfast in five.
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter and top with banana slices.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.

recipes.title: Turkey Ranch Pinwheels
recipes.description: Tortillas rolled up with cream cheese, turkey and crunchy veg, then sliced into lunchbox-ready spirals.
steps: Stir the cream cheese and ranch together until smooth.
Spread it over each tortilla, all the way to the edges.
Layer turkey, cheddar and spinach on top, then roll up tightly.
Slice into 1-inch pinwheels. Chill for 30 minutes first if you have time; they cut more neatly.

recipes.title: 15-Minute Shrimp Tacos
recipes.description: Smoky seared shrimp, crunchy slaw and a squeeze of lime in warm tortillas.
steps: Toss the shrimp with the paprika, cumin, garlic powder, a pinch of salt and the oil.
Stir the yogurt with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt. Toss half of it with the cabbage.
Sear the shrimp in a hot skillet for 2 minutes a side, until pink.
Warm the tortillas, then fill with slaw and shrimp. Spoon over the rest of the sauce and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chicken Nuggets
recipes.description: Golden, crunchy nuggets made from real chicken breast and baked, not fried. Dip them in anything.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season with salt.
Toss the panko with the olive oil in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden, about 3 minutes. Mix with the parmesan, garlic powder and paprika.
Beat the eggs in a bowl. Dip each piece in egg, then press into the crumbs.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until cooked through.

recipes.title: One-Pot Stovetop Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy, cheesy and faster than the boxed kind. The pasta cooks right in the milk.
steps: Bring the milk, 1 cup of water, the butter and a big pinch of salt to a simmer in a pot.
Add the pasta and cook, stirring often, for 9 to 11 minutes until tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheddar, mustard and garlic powder until creamy. Add a splash of milk if it's thick.

recipes.title: Pesto Pasta with Peas
recipes.description: Bright green, fresh and ready before the table is set. Jarred pesto makes it a 15-minute dinner.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water. Add the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Save half a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Toss with the pesto, parmesan, a squeeze of lemon and enough pasta water to make it silky.

recipes.title: Cheesy Breakfast Burritos
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs, cheddar and salsa wrapped up warm. Make extra and freeze them for busy mornings.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-low heat and stir the eggs slowly until just set.
Warm the beans and tortillas. Fill each tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese and salsa.
Fold in the sides and roll up. Toast seam-side down in the skillet for a minute to seal.

recipes.title: Apple Nachos
recipes.description: Crisp apple slices drizzled with warm peanut butter and chocolate, then showered with toppings. A snack kids can make.
steps: Toss the apple slices with a squeeze of lemon so they stay bright, then fan them out on a plate.
Warm the peanut butter for 20 seconds in the microwave and drizzle it over the apples.
Melt the chocolate the same way and drizzle it on too.
Scatter the granola over the top and serve right away.
